turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
I'm sitting, and the clock is running. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard first, yes or no, and what do you actually have?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
Agree? The zero comes off, Hale, and you've shown me nothing that says otherwise. Flatter me again and I go straight to the principal's office.
